title: Redwood - Vanilla Expanded
description: A mod that adds a vanilla friendly redwood forest
body:
# Vanilla Expanded
Vanilla expanded is a work in progress modpack that aims to create a **vanilla friendly** overhaul to minecraft. This is one mod from the modpack, it adds the following:
## Blocks & Biomes
- Full set of redwood blocks
- Redwood forest

## Mobs
- Duck
- Beaver
- Owl

## Structures
- Redwood Building
